app.title: Show HN: A Truly Modular Keyboard
app.author: NotARoomba
app.description: Open‑source modular keyboard firmware and hardware schematics, enabling customizable key layouts and programmable macros.
proposed_tests: Clone the repository and compile the firmware using make
Flash the compiled firmware to a compatible keyboard and verify key mapping
Load a custom JSON configuration file and confirm macro execution
Measure boot time from power-on to ready state
Compare key repeat latency against a standard QMK build
